Gradle wrapper bootstrap jar
============================

Vendored asset: gradle-wrapper.jar (beside this file)
Owner:          Gradle Inc. and the Gradle contributors
Licence:        Apache License 2.0
Licence source: https://github.com/gradle/gradle/blob/master/LICENSE
Source:         committed by Gradle's own `gradle wrapper` task, which copies
                the jar out of the distribution named in
                gradle-wrapper.properties
Distribution:   gradle-9.7.0-bin.zip, whose SHA-256 the wrapper verifies on
                download through `distributionSha256Sum` in
                gradle-wrapper.properties
Recorded:       2026-08-19

sha256=7a9ce74cff467ca1bf60a4fcd9f05185acceda4d0f382434d393e17864262c5d

This jar is build tooling and never reaches a shipped artifact, so it carries
no attribution duty in the product's credits page. It is recorded anyway for
one reason: it is executable third-party code that runs on every developer's
machine and on any builder, committed as bytes rather than resolved from a
lockfile. A checksum is the only thing that distinguishes the jar Gradle wrote
from one somebody swapped, and the Gradle version pin in TOOLCHAIN.md covers
the distribution rather than this bootstrapper.

Replacing it is Gradle's job, not a person's: bump the Gradle row in
TOOLCHAIN.md and gradle-wrapper.properties together, run `./gradlew wrapper`,
and update the `sha256` above in the same change.
